MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

7. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.

8. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.

10. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

14. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
